description: Independent source-permission prerequisite for .3. Keep existing no-source compatibility behavior only for genuinely non-source documents; reject missing/untrusted provenance on canonical data_source documents before legacy pruning. Real Repo/Permissions and mapping, stub only external providers. Documentation: owning module docs/service contract. Reuse decision: extend ExternalPermissions and existing generic Permissions grant/revoke/replace ownership primitives; IngestWorker existing caller remains thin. No new Action/tool (domain permission projection primitive). Inputs trusted record+matching Document, results checked success/error; ensure outer transaction rolls back all failures. Read AGENTS/tool/workflow/test/action/ingestion/permissions conventions. Focused tests+q; no precommit/push. Root review and isolated commit required before closure.
